title: VWP Provenance
description: Records how the package was created: by whom, with which tools, models, policies, and source systems. Verification never requires the recorded models or tools.

sessionDigest.description: Ties the package to an append-only agent-session transcript held by the producing system, without embedding its content. The digest is a hash-chain head over the session's ordered events.

system.description: The system that holds the session transcript.

sessionId.description: Identifier of the session within that system.

transcriptSha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 hash-chain head over the session's ordered events at package creation.

eventCount.description: Number of events covered by the digest.

models.description: AI models that materially shaped package content. Each entry MUST identify the exact model, so downstream reviewers can deliberately select a different model for independent analysis.

name.description: Exact model identifier as published by the provider (e.g. 'claude-fable-5'), not a family or marketing name.

version.description: Model version or snapshot date; use the provider's most specific identifier available.

role.description: What the model did, e.g. 'fact extraction', 'claim drafting', 'rendering'.
